commits.message:
fix(host): review — Alt sequences, Ctrl range, sideways wheel, quit-key names, late handler errors (rich-demos-k78j.4yc)

ESC ESC [ A is Alt+Up and ESC <ctrl> is Alt+Ctrl, not escape; 0x00 and
0x1c-0x1f name Ctrl+Space and Ctrl+\ ] ^ _; Alt+printable is keyed by its
glyph; SGR wheel 66/67 are scroll_left/right. quitKeys parse against keyName's
grammar and throw on a name no key goes by. A handler that stops the app is
the last to hear the event, and an error after stop throws instead of
vanishing. Dead Ctrl+C handlers removed from four demos.

feat(host): App reads keys — onKey/onMouse, Ctrl+C quits, quitKeys (rich-demos-k78j.4yc)

The byte parser moves from widgets/EventRouter down to host/input.ts.
App owns the one host.onData subscription and parser; WidgetApp's router
routes what App hears. keyName() is the one name per key; quitKeys
(default ["ctrl+c"], [] removes) are checked before any handler. A
handler that throws fails the app.

The four App demos (claude-sessions, rich-explore, rich-dash,
effects-feel) drop their TextDecoders, escape literals and try/fail
routing; keymaps are keyed by keyName.

WidgetApp now quits on Ctrl+C too, since it is an App: docs/widgets.md
drops the hand-written Ctrl+C handler.

test(e2e): page errors carry their stacks (rich-demos-k78j.4rx) (#376)

* test(e2e): page errors carry their stacks (rich-demos-k78j.4rx)

The scores-table page error failed one run and never again: ~800 runs since,
6x CPU throttle included, are clean, and the one failure kept only its message.
Every spec now collects page errors through pageErrors(), which keeps the stack,
so a recurrence names where it threw.

* fix(e2e): a frameless page error keeps its message (rich-demos-k78j.4rx)
